response.sql: WITH station_usage AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_usage) AS overall_avg FROM station_usage) SELECT AVG(s.avg_usage) AS mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(s.avg_usage - b.overall_avg) AS mean_amount_above_average FROM station_usage AS s CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE s.avg_usage > b.overall_avg;

assumptions.assumption: The comparison average is the average of station averages, giving each station equal weight.

alternatives.interpretation: Compare each station’s average with the average across all telescopes, giving each telescope equal weight in the benchmark.
